ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of plant cell structure, with multiple letter labels and leader lines around it. The letter I is located at the lower left of the image, and its horizontal leader line enters the inside of the cell to the right, pointing to an oval organelle on the inner lower left side. Inside this oval structure there are many strip-like, stacked, or striped membrane structures. Reasoning: In plant cell diagrams, an organelle with an oval shape and internal stacked membrane structures usually represents a chloroplast. Therefore, the structure corresponding to the letter I is chloroplast.
